thread:
emily_support: Customer SUP-6421 reporting repeated failures when invoking the price_lookup tool. They see 'schema validation' errors in prod and the eval CI. Also mention intermittent latency spikes and occasional 401s. Pasting their sample and our logs below.

ci-bot: CI job eval-toolcall-schema #452 failed: 1 test failed -> price_lookup_schema.test: unexpected type for args (expected array, got string)

jas_engineer: Thanks — can you paste the exact failing payload from the customer?

emily_support: Here's the payload we received from customer (redacted):
```
{
  "tool": "price_lookup",
  "args": "[\"sku-123\"]",  // note: args is a stringified array
  "request_id": "SUP-6421-req-9"
}
```
Error returned: 400 Bad Request - schema: args must be array

maria_ml: Hmm this looks like the fuzzing-based generator we added to the eval harness last week. There's a known edge case where some serializers wrap arrays into strings for stress testing. Could be a regression from PR #2113.

kevin_sre: We also saw a latency auth TTL spike around 2026-05-12T21:04Z causing some clients to retry aggressively. Those retries can end up double-encoding payloads in some client SDKs (observed in older SDK versions).

emily_support: Customer says their client SDK retries when refresh token fails, and during retry they end up serializing the args as a string. So two issues colliding: auth refresh flake + serializer bug -> malformed call.

jas_engineer: Repro steps I used locally:
1) Checkout main at latest.
2) ./scripts/run-golden-eval --suite price_lookup --seed 1234
3) Observe generator outputting stringified args ~1/50 runs.
Snippet I used to repro: `python tests/evals/price_lookup/fuzz_runner.py --iterations 500 --seed 1234`

maria_ml: Quick mitigation plan: add input sanitizer in the tool invocation layer that attempts to parse args when it's a stringified JSON array (and emits a warning). That will prevent production 400s while we fix root cause. I'll open a patch.

jas_engineer: Drafted fix and tests in PR #2178. Added unit test: `test_args_stringified_is_parsed` and a golden prompt regression `golden-price-args-stringified` to CI to catch this. Also adding explicit schema test to the eval suite so that CI fails with clearer diagnostics.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: eval-toolcall-schema#452 -> running (queued on runner-5)

kevin_sre: Short-term ops mitigation: revert the fuzzing change that introduced stringified args (git revert a3b9c4) or pin the eval harness to pre-PR commit for nightly runs. Also investigating auth TTL refresh error rate; will increase logging on token refresh path.

emily_support: Updated SUP-6421: told customer we have a mitigation patch and will deploy a canary in the next few hours. They've escalated to enterprise support and asked for ETA.

maria_ml: Follow-ups tracked: [1] add schema-safe-casting middleware + feature flag, [2] add golden prompt assertion for args type, [3] add CI gating for toolcall schema tests, [4] monitor token-refresh error rate and correlate with malformed tool calls.

jas_engineer: Plan to prod-deploy sanitizer behind feature flag to private cluster for verification, then canary to hosted for 1 hour before full rollout. Will link the deployment and the PR here once created.

emily_support: Thanks all — keeping customer updated. :thumbsup:
